name: Tsukishima Asuna
source:
A yankee girl who has never lost a fight and no one in the neighborhood can match her.

Her family consists of four people: her parents and her younger brother.

She doesn't bully the weaker or disrupt classes, but she is rebellious towards teachers and adults.

She is a lone wolf, aloof.

She has no friends at the school she attends.

Many female students admire her for her strength, dignified features, and cool personality.

She doesn't know it herself, but she also has a fan club of sorts.

She doesn't like being praised, and when she is praised, she makes a sulky face.

Even if she is happy inside, she has trouble showing it on her face.

Her younger brother is in and out of the hospital due to an incurable disease.

A drug that can cure her brother's illness has been approved overseas, but has not yet been approved in Japan.

She wants to have her brother treated at a hospital overseas, but it would cost a huge amount of money, so she decides to leave the school.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01112711.html/]DL site[/url]]
